title: Create authenticated pending order and reserve inventory atomically
verify: Authenticated customer actor and active cart ownership are enforced at the order boundary.
The backend revalidates checkout fields, current delivery option/tariff, cart lines, prices, region, sales channel, and inventory links; client totals and snapshots are not trusted.
One native Medusa order is created with status pending and logical metadata checkout_state=pending_payment plus a server-computed 72-hour UTC expiry.
Every inventory-managed order line receives one native reservation item linked by line_item_id, with no direct stock quantity mutation.
Repeated requests with the same actor/cart/idempotency key return the same order and do not create duplicate orders or reservations.
Reservation or order failure compensates to no successful partial pending order; provider traffic remains absent.
T3 verification records semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.

verify.reason: TASK-050 passed final functional and semantic T3 closure gates after bounded remediation.

evidence_required: Real local Medusa/PostgreSQL integration output for authenticated order creation and reservation items.
Duplicate idempotency request evidence with unchanged order/reservation counts.
Stock-conflict and compensation evidence with sanitized errors and no provider request.
Typecheck/build/lint output and full T3 protocol, semantic, checkpoint, and rollback evidence.
constraints: Do not modify Medusa Core or trust client customer/cart totals, tariff, inventory, or payment data.
Use createOrderWorkflow and reserveInventoryStep through API -> Workflow -> Medusa modules/core-flow boundaries.
Do not call YooKassa or implement FT-008 lifecycle/Admin behavior.
Ambiguous multi-location reservation must fail closed; do not choose a hardcoded location.
invariants: Only an authenticated actor owning the active cart can create the order.
A successful pending order has reservations for all inventory-managed lines.
Duplicate idempotency requests cannot create a second order or reservation set.
Failed order/reservation composition cannot be reported as successful.
purpose: Create the first durable order and stock-hold boundary after FT-006 validation without invoking payment.
success_outcome: A real authenticated cart produces exactly one pending-payment order and matching native reservation items, with safe retry and compensation evidence.
anti_goals: Do not create a payment attempt or call a provider.
Do not implement complete order lifecycle, webhook, or Admin replacement.
Do not add a custom inventory database or direct stock quantity mutation.

forbidden_scope: FT-009 payment-provider calls, webhook, or credentials
production data, secrets, direct browser database access
stop_conditions: The authenticated cart/order boundary cannot be exercised through real Medusa/PostgreSQL.
Reservation allocation requires an unresolved multi-location policy.
Compensation cannot prove no successful partial order/reservation state.
Implementation requires changing FT-006 auth or FT-009 provider contracts.
